ValidationRule.description: If the picklist value "Other" is selected for the field "TTS Offering" on the TTS Opportunity page, the "Other TTS Offering" field is required.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND( RecordType.Name ='TTS OTCRM Opportunity', ISBLANK( Other_TTS_Offering__c ), ISPICKVAL( TTSOffering__c , 'Other') ), AND( RecordType.Name ='TTS OTCRM Opportunity', NOT(ISBLANK( Other_TTS_Offering__c )), NOT(ISPICKVAL( TTSOffering__c , 'Other')) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill out "Other TTS Offering" only if "Other" was chosen as the TTS Offering field. If you did not choose "Other", leave it blank.
